title: Silence with a Purpose on the Form
story: Final-year students could remain after the library doors closed, but only in the downstairs carrels, and only after signing for the sources they still needed. Harun signed, then spent the hour sorting notes instead of opening the archive boxes he had named. The librarian did not scold the mismatch. The next week she checked the after-hours list against materials requested from the desk. The privilege existed to finish research the daytime crowd made hard, not to supply a quiet room for work that could happen anywhere. Harun stayed, and he ordered the boxes first. The library would protect that silence only when the form was telling the truth.
